drivingQuestion: Are the four shavings performed as a mitzva or only to remove hair grown in impurity?
outcomeNote: Dilemma raised; resolved in the next unit.

segments.he: שֶׁתִּגְלַחַת הַנֶּגַע וְכוּ׳. בָּעֵי רָמֵי בַּר חָמָא: הָנֵי אַרְבַּע תִּגְלָחִיּוֹת דְּקָאָמַר, מִשּׁוּם מִצְוָה, אוֹ מִשּׁוּם אַעְבּוֹרֵי שְׂעַר טוּמְאָה?
segments.en: § The mishna taught «that the shaving of leprosy» overrides the shaving of a nazirite only when he is a confirmed leper. «Rami bar Ḥama raises a dilemma: Those four shavings about which» the tanna «spoke,» the four that a nazirite performs for his leprosy and impurity, are they all «due to» the «mitzva» of shaving, «or» are some of them not performed for the sake of a mitzva, but «for the sake of removing hair» that grew in «impurity,» so that other hair can grow?

moves.summary: Takes up the mishna's clause on leprosy shaving
moves.about: lemma: leprosy shaving overrides nazirite shaving
